entry.title: Read row-specific Maximo detail textarea after selecting its table row
entry.description: A Maximo table may show one selected row's detail pane outside the table body. For row-specific supplemental fields, resolve the target table prefix from headers, find its currentrow, click the row's C:0 tgdet-ti control if needed, and resolve all textarea ids through semantic label/for relationships in the full page. Partial row-selection responses may update a textarea without its label, or omit an unchanged textarea entirely. Apply updates by known control id and retain omitted rendered values after confirming row selection.
applicable_when: A Maximo table row has a supplemental textarea in the selected-row detail pane
Reading multiple rows where each row may have different detail values
advantages: Avoids mixing the first row's detail with another row
disadvantages: Requires an additional read-only selection event for nonselected rows
recommended_when: The target table has currentrow and a row-select tgdet-ti control
notes: In ZZ_CMWO, the 故障現象 value 其它問題 has a separate 其它故障現象 textarea under the target table's tdet-chld detail pane.
Validated against the 2026-10-05 C2 HAR and live C1/C2 HTTP queries; selecting a noncurrent C2 row returned its own textarea in a partial Maximo event response.
Keep the original value when the supplemental textarea is empty; append a full-width colon and its text only when nonempty.

Live ZZ_CMWO work order 115-C2-38264 has four rows with blank 其它故障現象. Row selection responses confirm currentrow changes but omit unchanged textarea elements; retaining the blank rendered value returns all four rows.

Live ZZ_CMWO work order 115-C2-41266 now has three rows; the third uses 其它問題, 其它原因, and 其它, with separate textareas labeled 其它故障現象, 其它故障原因, and 其它處置措施. The selection response updated all three textarea values but omitted the first label.
